title: Settings
pageContext: Configure how Jawab24 responds to your page activity.
advancedDescription: Customize business hours, replies and more
presetRepliesCardDesc: Keyword-triggered replies for common short questions
aiDescription: Let Smart Reply handle comments and messages automatically
escalationDesc: Notify me when comments or messages go unanswered
handoffPauseDurationDesc: When you take over a conversation, smart reply pauses for this duration

replyStyle.title: Brand Voice
replyStyle.desc: Tell Jawab24 about your business — what to always say, never say, special offers.
replyStyle.brandVoicePlaceholder: Tone & style only — e.g. 'Be friendly, use emojis, speak casually'. For business info (prices, hours, contacts) add it to the Knowledge Base instead.
replyStyle.example1: Always mention free shipping over 200 SAR
replyStyle.example3: Mention our Riyadh showroom for large orders
replyStyle.testNoPages: Connect a Facebook or Instagram page first to test.
replyStyle.holdLowConfidenceDesc: When the AI can't find the answer in your Knowledge Base, it will hold the reply for you to review and send manually — instead of sending a vague "let me check" response automatically.
replyStyle.holdMovedNotice: Review Uncertain Replies moved to Advanced Settings

deleteAccountWarning: Warning: This action will permanently delete your account and all associated data, including connected pages and preset replies. This cannot be undone.

businessHoursError.hint: Please select an end time that comes after the start time

autoReplyDescription: Turn automatic replies on or off

commentReplyMode.question: When someone comments, what should happen?
commentReplyMode.dualDesc: We reply on the comment and send details privately using Smart Replies.
commentReplyMode.publicDesc: Jawab24 will reply to every comment automatically.
commentReplyMode.privateDesc: Jawab24 will send a private message using Smart Replies. No comment reply.

replyModeDescription: Reply on the comment or via private message
dualReplyDesc: Short comment reply + full private message
dualReplyConfigDesc: Full details will be sent automatically in a private message.
dualReplyConfigHelper: Max 80 characters • No links • Keep it short
dualReplyVariationsHint: Variations with the same meaning are generated automatically to keep replies fresh
dualReplyEmptyWarning: This field is empty — the placeholder text will be used as the comment reply
publicReplyPlaceholder: Details sent in a private message 📩
commentsAutoReplyDesc: Auto reply to comments on your page
commentsAutoReplyHelper: When enabled, choose how to reply: on comments, via message, or both.
businessHoursDesc: Auto-reply during work hours, send away message outside

businessHours.flowDesc: Auto-reply is active during business hours. Outside these hours, an away message is sent.

awayMessageConnectedDesc: Sent to customers outside work hours or when auto-reply is off
awayMessageDefault: Thanks for your message! We're currently away and will get back to you as soon as possible.
awayMessagePlaceholder: Thanks for your message. We'll reply soon.
greetingMessagePlaceholder: Hello! How can we help you?

reminders.title: Reply Reminders
reminders.desc: Get notified when comments or messages haven't been replied to
reminders.helpText: Set how long to wait before sending a reminder

handoffPause.title: Pause Auto-Reply When I Reply Manually
handoffPause.desc: When you manually reply to a message, auto-reply pauses to prevent duplicate responses. Choose how long.
handoffPause.warning: Ⅱ️ Prevents sending double replies to the same customer
handoffPause.why: Why? Prevents sending double replies to the same customer.

replyDelay.title: Reply Delay
replyDelay.desc: A short pause before each reply makes it feel more human
replyDelay.tip: We recommend 2-5 seconds for the most natural feel
replyDelay.example: The actual wait varies slightly each time so it feels natural
replyDelay.formula: Each reply waits between half and 1.5× your set time

greetingMessage.title: First Message to New Customers
greetingMessage.desc: Sent when a customer messages you for the first time

awayMessage.title: After-Hours Message
awayMessage.desc: Sent when customers message outside business hours

limitFallbackMessage.title: Backup Reply at Monthly Limit
limitFallbackMessage.desc: Sent to customers when your monthly Smart Reply limit is reached.
limitFallbackMessage.toggleLabel: Send a reply when the monthly limit is reached
limitFallbackMessage.helperOff: Off — no reply is sent at the limit. Comments and DMs are flagged in your inbox for manual handling.
limitFallbackMessage.emptyOnPreview: If left empty, customers will see: “{defaultText}”

limitFallbackMessagePlaceholder: Thanks for reaching out! We'll get back to you shortly.
aiDescriptionImproved: Use Smart Replies to generate context-aware responses. When disabled, only preset replies work. Works with 'Reply to Comments' and 'Reply to Messages' settings above.
bilingualTip: 💡 Tip: Write in one language, then auto-translate to reach all customers
businessHoursErrorMsg: End time must be after start time
